item.title: Blueprint Hilltop 1 Construction Update
item.description:
Please note that construction schedules are subject to change due to weather, site issues, etc. 

Unsure about which is your area? Visit the Blueprint map and enter your address to find out! 

Sump pump installations are offered for a limited time only! Contact us and we’ll get you on the waitlist for your no-obligation assessment!

Reminder: If you have a basement backup (sewer water coming up from your floor drain), please report this to the City by calling 614-645-7102. Please note that crews are working diligently to investigate issues throughout the city, so response will not be immediate. We appreciate your patience and understanding. 

Hilltop 1 Construction Update - Week of October 9, 2023

Palmetto-Westgate, Green Infrastructure

Construction Activities

  • Regional basin construction will begin in Westgate Park - Work will involve excavation, storm sewer, and landscaping improvements

Traffic Impacts

  • Construction vehicles will be entering and leaving Westgate Park
  • No lane restrictions 

Have a question or concern about construction?  Give us a call at 614-645-1253 or email blueprint@columbus.gov.

item.title: Thank You for Your Neighborhood's Participation in Our Public Meeting!
item.description:
Thank You Palmetto/Westgate!

Dear Palmetto/Westgate Residents,

We want to express our appreciation to the entire neighborhood for your remarkable participation in our July 18th public meeting. Your engagement, valuable insights, and active involvement have played a vital role in shaping the decisions and actions taken by Blueprint in your area. Your dedication showcases the strength and unity of your community.

To stay informed about the progress of our initiatives and upcoming events, please visit our official website blueprintneighborhoods.com. There, the presentation from the public meeting is currently available. In the coming days the a virtual version of the meeting will be available as well. If you would like to sign up for weekly construction updates and have not had the chance to do so, please sign up here. Your continued support is essential as we strive to create positive and impactful changes in our Blueprint neighborhoods.

Once again, thank you for your outstanding collaboration and active participation.

Warm regards,
The Blueprint Columbus Team
